item.title: 【MTV HD】PACK - The Last Days of MTV (1080i H.264 DD2.0)
item.description:
Well, since Paramount/MTV is shutting down most of its channels worldwide, I'm going to post some complete playlists here, uncut and unedited. The idea is to update this thread daily until the fateful day of December 31st, the date when the music will be completely removed from the schedule.
Any help is welcome. If you still subscribe to MTV and want to contribute, just send a message.

Here's some MTV Germany 5-ish hour playlist, aired on Dec 22th. New music + Christmas favourites.

Video: MPEG4 Video (H264) 1920x1080 25fps [V: h264 high L4.0, yuv420p, 1920x1080]
Audio: Dolby AC3 48000Hz stereo 384kbps [A: German [deu] (ac3, 48000 Hz, stereo, 384 kb/s)]
